name: Two-photon polymerization
purpose: Print fine 3D scaffold structures and microfluidic masters.
geometryBrief: Hinged lid, print cabinet, objective, stage, joystick, focus panel and external rack.
behaviorBrief: Import volume, render voxel/hatch paths and feature-size limits; distinguish scaffold resin from cell-laden material.
inputs: Scaffold mesh, voxel kernel, hatch path and calibrated coordinate transform
outputs: Scaffold revision with predicted solid volume, voxel grid and unresolved-feature flags
acceptance: Render two parallel rods at successively wider separations. Resolve two components when their modeled voxel footprints separate and recover center spacing to within one voxel.

name: Extrusion bioprinter
geometryBrief: Enclosure, print bed, toolheads, cartridge mounts and screen.
behaviorBrief: Toolpath, nozzle/material assignment, construct geometry and cell-state bookkeeping.
inputs: Labeled toolpaths, nozzle footprints, material IDs and scaffold carrier
outputs: Scaffold revision with strand geometry, material labels and per-material deposited volume
acceptance: Print two synthetic lines with different tool assignments. Check their centerlines, preserve material order at crossings and compare each straight strand volume with cross-section times length.

name: Light-based bioprinter
purpose: Pattern photocurable hydrogel constructs by light.
geometryBrief: Projection enclosure, resin/gel vat, build platform and control screen.
behaviorBrief: Layer exposure and geometry; viability and curing effects only with supporting data.
inputs: Binary slice masks, layer spacing, virtual exposure-response curve and carrier ID
outputs: Construct revision with predicted solid mask per layer and spatial resolution
acceptance: Expose a three-layer resolution staircase with an all-dark control layer. Its three footprints must match the input at the ideal threshold and the dark layer must remain empty.

name: High-resolution resin printer
purpose: Print jigs and larger non-cellular scaffolds or molds.
geometryBrief: Lid, resin tank, platform, screen and cartridge.
behaviorBrief: Layer slicing, build envelope and support placement; not assume implant-safe resin.
inputs: Fixture mesh, build orientation, layer spacing, support geometry and documented build envelope
outputs: Sliced build job, support intersections and out-of-envelope flags
acceptance: Slice an axis-aligned rectangular block of height exactly ten layers. Recover ten occupied slices and flag the same block when translated past a build boundary.
geometryStatus: First pass: stationary standard Form 4 exterior, nominal size verified
simulationStatus: First pass: passive detached clearance only; actual production acceptance deferred
integrationStatus: First pass: simulator route, editable metric GLB, detached VR action and JSON example

name: Aligned fiber electrospinner
purpose: Produce oriented fibers for guidance scaffolds using drum collector.
geometryBrief: Enclosure, syringe holder, rotating collector, panel and camera.
behaviorBrief: Parameterized alignment distribution and fiber geometry; no real high-voltage process tutorial.
inputs: Collector frame, axial orientation distribution, length distribution and random seed
outputs: Scaffold revision containing fiber centerlines and a measured orientation histogram
acceptance: Generate isotropic and aligned planar fixtures. Their axial order magnitudes should approach zero and one respectively within the declared finite-sample tolerance.

name: Wire electrospinning
purpose: Create larger nanofiber sheets and comparison materials.
geometryBrief: Tall enclosure, substrate rollers, wire electrode and observation camera.
behaviorBrief: Fiber-density map and collector direction; manufacturer lists 1295 W x 1045 L x 2053 H mm.
inputs: Collector travel axis, sheet extent, synthetic fiber density field and random seed
outputs: Sheet revision with fiber density by area and collector-frame orientation map
acceptance: Generate a sheet with a known two-band density ratio. Recover that ratio within sampling uncertainty and rotate the map with the collector frame.

name: Pressure/flow controller
purpose: Perfuse microfluidic culture channels and regulate flow.
geometryBrief: Controller body, ports, tubing, reservoirs and flow sensors; CAD available for some related modules.
behaviorBrief: Flow and pressure network, residence time, shear estimate and sensor feedback.
inputs: Chip channel graph, hydraulic resistances, pressure boundary values and reservoir volumes
outputs: Run record with pressure, branch flow and volume-based residence time
acceptance: Use two identical parallel channels between fixed-pressure reservoirs. Each must carry half the total flow, satisfy Q = Δp/R and give equal residence times.

name: Modular pressure controller
purpose: Supply independent pressure channels for organ-on-chip rigs.
geometryBrief: Stackable modules, knobs/displays, manifold, tubes and sensors.
behaviorBrief: Closed-loop flow control using measured fluid properties.
inputs: Module-to-channel map, flow target, sensor readings and calibrated pressure limits
outputs: Controller log with commanded pressure, measured flow, settling error and limit flags
acceptance: Drive a known synthetic hydraulic resistance with a reachable target, then an unreachable one. Check settling against the specified controller tolerance and pressure limiting for the second case.

name: Syringe pump
model: New Era NE-1000 (confirm exact pump model)
purpose: Drive perfusion or dispense fluid in a scaffold rig.
geometryBrief: Motor housing, lead screw, syringe barrel and plunger clamp.
behaviorBrief: Flow, reservoir volume, occlusion and pressure proxy.
inputs: Syringe bore, plunger travel, remaining volume and connection to a virtual channel
outputs: Dispense event with delivered volume, remaining inventory and line status
acceptance: Advance a cylindrical syringe by a known displacement. Delivered volume must equal bore area times travel until empty, and repeated requests cannot dispense more than the initial inventory.

name: Soft-lithography casting station
model: Custom PDMS casting and curing bench
geometryBrief: Mixing cup, mold, vacuum desiccator, curing oven, biopsy punch and alignment jig.
behaviorBrief: Mold inversion, channel geometry, bonding status and defects.
inputs: Mold relief mesh, casting plane, port locations and bond alignment transform
outputs: Replica revision with channel geometry, port graph, bond state and defect annotations
acceptance: Invert a rectangular raised master feature. The replica must contain a recess of equal ideal depth and width. An intentionally misaligned port must fail the connectivity check.

name: Convection curing oven
model: Jeio Tech OF-12G (forced convection oven reference)
purpose: Cure compatible cast structures; this reference is a convection oven, not a vacuum oven.
geometryBrief: Door, shelves, control panel and sample trays; choose separate vacuum model if needed.
behaviorBrief: Temperature-time state and cure model; no simulated vacuum in this selected unit.
inputs: Cast-part ID, logged chamber temperature, initial part temperature and optional material calibration
outputs: Thermal history linked to the casting and a cure-state estimate when calibration exists
acceptance: Replay a constant chamber-temperature step with a first-order thermal fixture. Match its analytic time constant and leave quantitative cure unknown when the material curve is absent.

name: Microindentation
purpose: Measure small tissue or scaffold mechanical responses.
geometryBrief: Small load cell, probe, stage, microscope/camera and specimen chamber.
behaviorBrief: Force-displacement and creep data; calibration-dependent stiffness.
inputs: Specimen ID, displacement history, indenter geometry and force calibration
outputs: Measurement record with force–displacement, creep trace when available and stiffness estimate
acceptance: Load a virtual linear spring of known stiffness. After contact, recover the slope within the declared sensor tolerance and report zero load before contact.
